variants.headline: Accident at a workplace
variants.body: An accident has occurred at {facility}. The gazette records the development as a matter deserving careful attention in the public interest.

variants.headline: Workplace safety becomes immediate news

variants.headline: An accident enters the working day
variants.body: There has been an accident at {facility}. The gazette records the development as a matter deserving careful attention in the public interest.
